title: Liye
description: Fully client side 113 mod optimization pack
body:
# Liye
**If text looks weird in game and performance is not a priority, remove or disable "Tekst" in your launcher**

Simple modpack consisting of 113 client-side mods. Works on most servers, shouldn't get you banned in most scenarios.

Since Nvidium is used, you probably shouldn't use shaders, or Nvidium disables itself.
Nvidium _also_ hasn't been updated in a long time, so a workaround is in place to keep Nvidium working with the latest Sodium version.

Mostly optimization mods.





##  **Viaproxy for playing on unsupported servers** 

Viaproxy guide (only do step 1 once):
Step 1. Download ViaProxy (https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaProxy/releases/tag/v3.4.5, download a jar file)
Step 2. Double click the JAR file for ViaProxy
Step 3. Add your account in ViaProxy.
Step 4. Put the server's IP 
Step 5. Launch Minecraft.
Step 6. Add the IP Viaproxy gives you as a server
Step 7. Join the server
